items.summary: Shipping mobile and web products for logistics and B2B operations — from Flutter app to production release.
highlights: Engineered the Unibasket mobile app using Flutter and a Python backend for daily deliveries from verified local vendors.
Contributed to launching Unimatix.io, a cross-platform B2B project management tool using Framework7, Flutter, and CI/CD tools.
Managed concurrent MERN stack client projects, streamlined bug tracking and operations using Azure DevOps, and presented product demos.

items.summary: Built backend systems and conversational interfaces for healthcare and immersive therapy products.
highlights: Developed and maintained backend-driven systems for Manaha Clinic to support appointment scheduling and patient workflows.
Deployed a conversational AI kiosk, managing AI context and API integrations for real-time healthcare information.
Improved the user experience of VR-based flight-phobia treatments through usability testing and iterative interface refinements.

items.detail: Four years of computer science with a focus on systems, web engineering, and applied AI — and a lot of time spent shipping side projects.
highlights: Graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science in 2025.
Built the first versions of Lisa and Maargam alongside coursework.
